messages.author: ea9109a224210f54
messages.subject: Trouble installing INLA with RStudio.
parts:
I am having trouble installing INLA with RStudio. Any help would be appreciated. See below.
I downloaded INLA the "easy way", then got this message:
> source("http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/givemeINLA.R")
trying URL 'http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/binaries/INLA.zip'
Content type 'application/zip' length 39336093 bytes (37.5 Mb)
opened URL
downloaded 37.5 Mb

Warning in inla.installer(...) :
  argument 'lib' is missing: using 'C:/Program Files/R/R-2.15.1/library'
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : 
  could not find function ".getNamespace"
In addition: Warning messages:
1: package ‘sp’ was built under R version 2.15.3 
2: package ‘lattice’ was built under R version 2.15.3 
3: package ‘INLA’ was built under R version 3.1.0 
Error : unable to load R code in package ‘INLA’
Error: package/namespace load failed for ‘INLA’

When I download it the regular way:
> install.packages("C:/Office Computer/AARMS Summer School 2014/Computer Stuff/INLA.zip", repos = NULL)
Installing package(s) into ‘C:/Program Files/R/R-2.15.1/library’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
> library(INLA)
Loading required package: sp
Loading required package: Matrix
Loading required package: lattice
Loading required package: splines
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : 
  could not find function ".getNamespace"
In addition: Warning messages:
1: package ‘INLA’ was built under R version 3.1.0 
2: package ‘sp’ was built under R version 2.15.3 
3: package ‘lattice’ was built under R version 2.15.3 
Error : unable to load R code in package ‘INLA’
Error: package/namespace load failed for ‘INLA’

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Trouble installing INLA with RStudio.
parts: On Fri, 2014-07-11 at 10:28 -0700, 'Julie Horrocks' via R-inla

discussion group wrote:

> Warning in inla.installer(...) :
> argument 'lib' is missing: using 'C:/Program Files/R/R-2.15.1/library'

jepp, you need R >= R-3.0 in order to install the package.

to upgrade from R-2.15, I would reinstall all (local) libraries...
